name: Para Para 2
source:
Christmas is drawing closer. Girl's mother suggests part-time job at her family restaurant to earn money for girl's present. Main character agrees without giving it much thought, but it turns out to be family restaurant full of women and temptations...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-november-2001-nijuubako.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
圣诞节越来越近了。女孩的母亲建议在自家餐馆打工，赚点钱给女孩买礼物。主角想都没想就答应了，结果却发现这是一个充满女人和诱惑的家庭餐厅……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-november-2001-nijuubako.html]vndbreview[/url]]
